column1: # Where Chrome looks for its own window (BrowserView), which Rise's fork does not have: listed by
# scripts/engine/fork-reach-ins.py, reviewed. Columns: file, function, whether the code checks for the
# window (unchecked would crash if reached), verdict, why. Verdicts: unreached (Rise never runs it),
# harmless (does nothing without the window), rise (Rise does it its own way), todo (needs Rise's version).
# Also found by testing, outside these lookups or past their checks:
# - Chrome's dialogs for a page (a site's sign-in, screen sharing) ask the window for a dialog host,
#   which Rise gives them over the page (PageDialogHost in the bridge).
# - Device choosers (USB, serial, HID, Bluetooth) anchored through bubble_anchor_util, which used the
# - Chrome's windows over a Rise window (dialogs, bubbles) are made its children, so they move with
#   it; a page's picture-in-picture window is Chrome's own and floats.
